name: cloudmailin-proxy
description: Google Cloud Run Function (Gen 2) that proxies CloudMailin webhooks to path-scoped apps (e.g. bank OTP notifications)

scripts.deploy: pnpm create-env-yaml && gcloud functions deploy cloudmailin-proxy --runtime=nodejs22 --region=asia-south1 --source=. --entry-point=cloudmailinProxy --trigger-http  --allow-unauthenticated --env-vars-file .env.yaml
scripts.update-version: node scripts/update-version.js && pnpm install && pnpm format
